map.镜架前倾角调整器 使用指南: Frame pantoscopic tilt adjuster user guide
map.计算前倾角(Pantoscopic Tilt)对光学中心位置的影响与调整量: Computes the effect of pantoscopic tilt on optical center position and the required adjustment
map.按前倾角算光心下移量保视轴对齐。: Compute the optical center drop from the pantoscopic tilt to keep the visual axis aligned.
map.前倾角 5–9° 为宜。: A pantoscopic tilt of 5-9° is advisable.
map.渐进片对倾斜角更敏感。: Progressive lenses are more sensitive to tilt angle.
map.：前倾角 8° → 光心下移量=8×0.5=4mm；若不做相应下移，视线偏高产生: : Pantoscopic tilt 8° -> optical center drop = 8 x 0.5 = 4 mm; without the corresponding drop, the line of sight sits too high and produces prism and aberration.
map.：前倾角 <5° 视野偏上、>9° 像差增大且镜片外凸，5–9° 兼顾下方阅读与: : Pantoscopic tilt below 5° puts the field of view too high, above 9° aberration increases and the lens bulges outward; 5-9° balances the lower reading zone and appearance.
map.让镜片更垂直视轴、优化下方阅读区（尤其渐进），并改善美观贴合。: Makes the lens more perpendicular to the visual axis, optimizes the lower reading zone (especially for progressives), and improves cosmetic fit.
map.镜面与面部垂线夹角，配镜仪或量角器测，配渐进须精确并据此移光心。: The angle between the lens plane and the vertical line of the face, measured with a dispensing instrument or protractor; for progressives it must be measured precisely and the optical center moved accordingly.
